versions.changelog:
Academic Paper Workflow: Transparent, Auditable AI-Powered End-to-End Paper Writing Process

- Introduces a full 7-stage workflow for academic paper production covering research, writing, citation, integrity checking, peer review, final validation, and journal formatting.
- Integrates 8 specialized skills (literature search, deep research, academic writing, citation formatting, integrity check, peer review, final validation, journal formatting) with clear division of responsibility.
- Emphasizes transparency, auditability, traceability, and enforced AI hallucination prevention via multiple rounds of validation and review.
- Provides detailed step-by-step guidance, decision checkpoints, and roles for both AI and human users for use cases such as SCI reviews, grant proposals, and research reports.
- Includes best practices, pitfalls to avoid, time estimates for each stage, parallelization opportunities, and real-world usage scenarios.
- Offers customization options for new skills, journal templates, and phase adjustment for various academic document types.
